title: In the End
lyrics:
[00:17.66]It starts with one
[00:19.00]One thing, I don't know why
[00:21.19]It doesn't even matter how hard you try
[00:23.47]Keep that in mind, I designed this rhyme
[00:25.52]To explain in due time
[00:27.05]All I know
[00:28.76]Time is a valuable thing
[00:30.34]Watch it fly by as the pendulum swings
[00:32.73]Watch it count down to the end of the day
[00:34.67]The clock ticks life away
[00:35.96]It's so unreal
[00:37.84]Didn't look out below
[00:39.48]Watched the time go right out the window
[00:41.76]Trying to hold on, but didn't even know
[00:43.99]I wasted it all just to watch you go
[00:47.00]I kept everything inside and even though I tried
[00:49.68]It all fell apart
[00:51.00]What it meant to me, will eventually
[00:52.79]Be a memory, of a time when I tried so hard
[00:56.43]And got so far
[00:59.31]But in the end
[01:01.01]It doesn't even matter
[01:03.27]I had to fall
[01:05.53]To lose it all
[01:08.40]But in the end
[01:10.07]It doesn't even matter

[01:30.04]I'm surprised it got so far
[01:32.15]Things aren't the way they were before
[01:34.85]You wouldn't even recognize me anymore
[01:36.90]Not that you knew me back then
